claim: Meta expects 2026 capital expenditures of $130 billion to $145 billion.
summary: Without tools, Meta's 2026 capital expenditure guidance of $130 billion to $145 billion cannot be verified or refuted as of 2026-10-28; no evidence is available to confirm the issuer, period, metric, or range.
